name: Malific Meteor
body:
School evocation [earth]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 3

Components: V,S,M (a tiny piece of volcanic or meteoric rock)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target(s): One creature

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

The caster summons a small meteor and sends it hurtling toward a single foe. The meteor travels in a straight line and the caster must have line of sight to the target. On impact, the target suffers 1d6 bludgeoning damage per two levels of the caster (max 8d6), Reflex save for half. Targets who fail their save are knocked back 10 feet away from the caster and fall prone. If an obstacle prevents the target from getting knocked back, the target and the obstacle each take 1d6 points of damage, and the target stops in the space adjacent to the obstacle. Flying targets are knocked back but do not fall.
